selection: All freshly predeclared confirmation fits and updates. No refitting or outcome selection after seeing these bounds.
independent_cohort: Fresh seeds167/193, both image datasets/k3/5/ages and representations; count natural regressions actually observed.
group_interval: Exact assigned-group aggregate plus bounds on the difference of switching advantages. Paired version subtracts group movement before bounding residual norms.
refinement: Descending correction-interval width with row-index tie break; select before consulting exact corrections; fixed budget ceilings.
scope: Native screening of an auxiliary certificate basis rounded from the frozen basis. Original prediction outputs remain frozen. No proof-speed claim.
preprocessing: Exact old nearest labels computed from the fixed catalog before future centers. The proof profile must enforce this old argmin on every row.
fast_path: A<0 implies true improvement only after the exact-old preprocessing proof. No per-row query bounds needed on this path.
